what_happened: The question split cleanly and decisively on primary sources alone: Reynolds 2001 sec04 gives theta_A verbatim (acceptance-condition-free, confirming Muller suffices for the AA rule) and sec06 gives the chronicle definition bl : T -> (C x {1..K})* where K is the number of ACCEPTING PAIRS, which settles the ban/lull half negatively in one read. No Lean work, no web search, no literature beyond the held Reynolds chunks.

Derived a two-state countermodel (Q={a,b}, accept={{a,b}}) showing the naive pair-enumeration of a Muller family is not merely incomplete for the DMA->DRA conversion (as cslib DA/Conversions.lean's own docstring notes) but UNSOUND for the Reynolds construction: it makes phi-plus inconsistent. Same example proves Muller is strictly more expressive than Rabin on a fixed state space, so the LAR blowup is unavoidable. Turns an impressionistic 'presentational preference' question into a settled negative.

The dispatch (inherited from report 902's (O1) and its Risks section) framed the Rabin/parity requirement as possibly 'a presentational preference rather than a real need', on the ground that Muller acceptance is as expressible by fresh atoms as Rabin's. That ground is correct but load-bears only on the AA rule; the ban/lull mechanism was not covered by it and is pair-shaped by construction. Report 902's Risks bullet therefore overstated the likelihood that (O1) would vanish. Recorded so the amendment to 902 is traceable.

All 14 amendment anchors named by the research report's recommendations 1-3 were confirmed present exactly once at plan time by grepF across the 902 report, the 902 summary, the 879 report and specs/ROADMAP.md, so no phase below rests on an unverified correction target. ROADMAP line 119-120 additionally carries a live 'owned by 903' open-question pointer that the report's recommendations do not name but that this task's verdict closes; it is planned as its own phase.

The dispatch's deploy-freshness context names agent-system/extensions/ as a stale source store, but no agent-system/ tree exists in this repository and .claude-extensions.json carries no source_dir key. The warning is therefore unactionable here (same root cause 902 measured: this tree is a deploy consumer with no reachable source store). Handed forward, not acted on; no phase claims a redeploy.

Plan authored and validated clean on the first pass: validate-artifact.sh ... plan reported [PASS] with 0 warnings. Four phases, each with a Verification Tier; Tier Justification present on the three non-final phases and correctly omitted on the final one; wave table (1=[1,2,3], 2=[4]) consistent with the per-phase Depends on fields. The precedent plan at specs/902_.../plans/01_... supplied five reusable calibrations, chiefly its measured lesson that an 'anchor still matches once after the edit' criterion is unsatisfiable for anchors the phase itself replaces -- handled here by a per-anchor KEPT/REPLACED disposition table in every amendment phase.
